title: Health-related quality of life and function after Achilles tendon suture
summary:
The Achilles tendon is the strongest tendon in the human body. It is exposed to a high risk of acute rupture of the tendon during acceleration and deceleration motions (e.g. during running and jumping).
Early rehabilitation after surgical achilles tendon repair remains inconsistent. The term "early functional rehabilitation" is inconsistently defined internationally. In this study, a detailed early functional rehabilitation regimen will be implemented and the functional outcome will be described over a time course.

interventions.name: Patients with surgical treatment (suture) after Achilles tendon rupture are followed over a period of time. There is a regular recording of: A) the functional result and B) patient satisfaction. The uninjured side serves as a control.
Healthy side as a control (no surgery, just rehabilitation)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Achilles tendon rupture and surgical achilles tendon repair, prospective 2020-2025, German language skills.
Exclusion criteria:
Bilateral ruptures; multiple injuries, unless they are minor injuries (AIS=1) to the upper extremity.
